job.job_description:
Role: AI Engineer




Required skill set: GenAI, ML, DL, NLP, Python




Must have skills:

GenAI, LLMs, Python
API Development, Microservices Architecture, End-to-End

Integrations

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), CI/CD Pipelines
Containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
GCP (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Redis, NoSQL

Databases)

Maintaining chat history, Auto Scaling (Prometheus, Dynatrace,

LangSmith)

Machine Learning, Deep Learning, TensorFlow, NLP
PyCharm, Numpy, Pandas
MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL, RDBMS Design and Modelling
GitHub, Jenkins
Data Modelling, Data Wrangling, Data Extraction




Good to have:

Computer Vision problem solving, Advanced Pattern Matching
PII Identification and Extraction
Document Type Classifiers, Standardized Form Matchers



Expectations from the Role:

Hands-on experience with GenAI, Gemini or Open Source LLMs; ability to train,

finetune, and onboard new LLMs

Build GenAI applications using Python
API Development and Microservices Architecture, End-to-End Integrations
Knowledge of RAG, ADK, MCP
Solid understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and graph-based workflows
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), Harness, and

Git actions

Build scalable data pipelines and workflows on GCP (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow,

Pub/Sub, Redis, NoSQL Databases)

Implement best practices for data governance, security, and MLOps on GCP
Knowledge of API Gateways and ISTIO; ability to diagnose and intercept failures in

end-to-end communication

Optimize model performance, monitor production systems, ensure reliability, and

implement auto-scaling (Prometheus, Dynatrace, LangSmith)

Work on functional and process design (scenario design, flow mapping), prototyping,

testing, training, and defining support procedures in collaboration with engineering

teams and leadership

Articulate and document solution architectures and lessons learned for each exploration

and incubation

Conduct AI assessments for use cases, providing recommendations and alternative

solutions

Develop classification algorithms and prepare data
Experience in one or more areas: Image Processing, Text Extraction, Clustering,

Classification, Embedding Models

Develop drift detection and model monitoring implementations; experience with

AgentEvals for LLMs is a plus

Architect, position, and deliver data science and machine learning solutions
Experience with supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms; classification

algorithms preferred

Experience with document type classifiers, pattern matching, and PII identification
Hands-on model training, drift detection, and feature generation
Expertise in Agile methodologies and frameworks
